summary: Kenny dies with the injection still in his hand, and he gives it to Levi. A friend, in his story, was Uri. The squad that remains will ride together.

segments.ja: ケニーは、女王の祝う街の外で息を減らしています。減らす場所は、人目の少ない木の下です。木の下で、彼は力を得られなかった人生を数えます。数える相手は、ウーリと、クシェルと、リヴァイです。リヴァイが、その木の下に来ます。来た再会は、銃の再会ではありません。弾の尽きた静けさです。静けさの中で、ケニーは初めて長く座ります。その夜の火は、壁の内側で小さく残っています。残った火を、班は交代で見ていました。
segments.en: Kenny is reducing his breath outside the city the queen is celebrating. The place he reduces it is under a tree with few eyes. Under the tree, he counts a life that did not obtain the power. The people he counts are Uri, Kuchel, and Levi. Levi comes under that tree. The reunion that came is not a reunion of guns. It is a quiet after the bullets are gone. In the quiet, Kenny sits long for the first time. That night's fire remains small inside the wall. The squad was watching the remaining fire in turns.

segments.en: Kuchel is Kenny's sister and Levi's mother. The mother's house was a place far from clean. In that far place, Kenny found the boy, left the technique of violence, and went away. He says the reason he went away was for strength. The strength he says became the speed of today's Captain. He looks at the speed it became both like his own work and like a sin of leaving someone behind. The eyes that look no longer raise a gun.

segments.ja: ケニーが最後に繰り返すのは、友人です。友人は、ウーリです。ウーリは、殺人者の前に膝をつき、世界の間違いを直したいと言いました。言った関係を、ケニーは命令ではなく対等として覚えます。覚える対等は、アッカーマンには再現できない力でした。できない力を欲しがった一生が、ここで終わります。終わるとき、彼はリヴァイを友人とは呼びません。呼びませんが、注射を渡す相手に選びます。
segments.en: What Kenny repeats at the end is friend. The friend is Uri. Uri knelt in front of a killer and said he wanted to fix the mistake of the world. Kenny remembers the relationship he stated not as a command but as an equal. The equal he remembers was a power an Ackerman could not reproduce. The life that wanted the power it could not have ends here. When it ends, he does not call Levi a friend. Even not calling him that, he chooses him as the person to give the injection to.

segments.ja: ケニーのポケットの注射は、巨人の力を人に移す残りの一本です。一本を、彼は自分には使えなかったと言います。言えなかった理由は、血です。血の事実を、リヴァイは静かに受け取ります。受け取る品は、誰かを巨人にし、誰かを食わせる選択です。選択を、今日はまだ使いません。使わないまま、兵長はそれを外套の内にしまいます。しまうことが、後の白夜の重さです。
segments.en: The injection in Kenny's pocket is the one vial left that moves a Titan's power into a person. He says he could not use the one vial on himself. The reason he could not say otherwise is blood. Levi receives the fact of the blood quietly. The object he receives is a choice that makes someone a Titan and makes someone eat. They do not use the choice yet today. Without using it, the Captain puts it inside his coat. Putting it away is the weight of the later midnight sun.

segments.en: Kenny does not fire a showy last gun. The death he does not fire is bleeding under a tree. During the bleeding, he does not ask whether he was a good person. Instead of asking, he leaves only that he once had a friend. Levi does not make the one sentence he left into a gravestone. Instead of making it, he closes the place later, alone. The manner of closing is short. The short manner is the distance of their family. The tube of the injection is lighter in the palm than he thought. Being light is separate from the weight of the choice.

segments.en: The queen sets the word friend outside politics. The place she sets it is orphans and a field. In the field, she works while still having given up the right to call Ymir back. The squad sees the figure that works once, from far away. The once they see is a trust different from the fist of the crowning. The trust is that even as ruler she is a human on the side that eats. The human that is so has not stopped the expedition. Not stopping it makes the friends' departure possible. The voice just before death does not have the shape of an order. Levi listens to the end to the voice that does not.

segments.en: Armin once says aloud the contradiction of an expedition that pursues friends as enemies. The person he says it to is Jean. Jean does not resolve the contradiction, and still answers that he will ride. The reason he answers is the wings he chose after Marco. The wings are not a comfortable seat. Connie and Sasha share the seat that is not there, in the same wagon. The sharing is the substance of this episode's friends. The substance is the possibility of dying together, more than a clean definition. Before departure, a horse's girth is tightened once more. The hand that tightened it is the last of the night's preparation.

segments.en: When the talk of friends ends, the night of the expedition begins. The night that begins is the night before the operation to retake the wall. On that night before, the injection, the key, and the reduced roster are on the same saddle. The squad does not yet say the saddle that is there is heavy. The lightness of not saying it looks like a continuation of training. Ahead of the continuation that can be seen, Shiganshina is waiting. The city that is waiting will shave the definition of friend further. Before it shaves, today leaves one person under the tree. The road that remains is still dark. The line advances on the dark road with few lights.
